headline: Slope-only is the strongest honest baseline; multivariate models do not beat it with block-bootstrap CI separation.
notes: Slope test AUC 0.821 already strong; logreg slightly worse (0.803); HGB point 0.850 but ΔAUC CI [-0.070, 0.091] includes 0
Logreg per-block AUC <0.7 on several large western blocks (35_-125, 40_-125, 45_-120)
Partial dependence on slope is non-decreasing for logreg (plausibility PASS)
Validation set had only 7 positives — calibration unstable (high ECE)
Added environment layers not evaluated (Phase 5 skipped by protocol gate)
